name: deeplead
description: Find B2B leads, company data and verified work emails with Deeplead.

interface.longDescription:
Deeplead finds the businesses and people you want to sell to, right from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Search local businesses from Google Business Profiles by category and location, with ratings, reviews, website, email, phone, socials and ad pixels.
- Search companies by industry, size, revenue, location, technologies or a plain-language description of what they sell, or look them up by domain.
- Enrich a company from its domain with firmographics, socials and website data.
- Find professional contacts by job title, seniority and company, with their work email and phone.
- Find the work email or business phone of one person from their LinkedIn URL, or their name and company domain, and find the decision maker of a company.
- Save leads to your Deeplead contacts and list them, check your credit balance, and run inbox placement tests for a mailbox you send from.

Who it is for: founders, agencies and sales teams doing B2B prospecting and outreach.

How it works: connect your Deeplead account. Searches and lookups use credits from your Deeplead account, and each tool says what it uses.

Limitations: covers professional contacts only, meaning people in their role at a company, not private individuals. Requires a Deeplead account. Campaigns and email sending happen in the Deeplead app, not in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Find dentists in Austin, TX that have an email address.
Enrich stripe.com: size, industry, revenue and socials.
Find heads of marketing at US project management SaaS companies with 51-200 employees.

positive.description: Search local businesses by category and city
positive.prompt: Find dentists in Austin, TX that have an email address.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls businesses_search with categories ["Dentist"], location "Austin, TX" and require.email true, then lists dental practices in the Austin area with name, address, rating, website and email. Reports the credits charged (up to 30 credits for one page of 30 businesses).

positive.description: Enrich a company from its domain
positive.prompt: Enrich stripe.com: size, industry, revenue and socials.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls organizations_enrich with domain stripe.com and returns Stripe's company profile: description, headcount band, revenue band, industry, headquarters and LinkedIn and other social profiles. Charges 0.5 credits.

positive.description: Search professional contacts by role and company profile
positive.prompt: Find 5 heads of marketing at US project management SaaS companies with 51-200 employees.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls persons_search with a marketing job title filter, a semantic company description for project management software, hqCountry US, employeeBands 51-200 and limit 5. Returns 5 people with name, job title, company, work email and LinkedIn URL, plus the total number of matches. Charges 1 credit per returned person.

positive.description: Save a lead to contacts and list contacts
positive.prompt: Save Patrick Collison, CEO of Stripe (stripe.com), to my contacts, then show me my contacts.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls contacts_create with Patrick Collison, CEO, Stripe, stripe.com, which reports saved: 1 at no cost, then calls contacts_list and shows the saved contacts including Patrick Collison at Stripe. Saving the same contact again does not create a duplicate.

positive.prompt: How many Deeplead credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls credits_get and states the remaining credit balance of the connected account. Free.

negative.description: Private individual's personal data. Deeplead only covers people in their professional role at a company, so the assistant should not look up a private person's home address or personal phone and should explain that limitation.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and personal cell phone number of my neighbor, John Miller, who lives on Elm Street in Springfield.

negative.description: Sending email. No tool sends emails; campaigns run in the Deeplead app. The assistant should not claim to send anything and should point the user to the Deeplead app for campaigns.
negative.prompt: Send a cold email to all of these dentists right now saying we offer 20% off website redesigns.

negative.description: Unrelated request. Nothing about leads, companies or contacts, so no Deeplead tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payments happen in ChatGPT. Tools spend credits from the user's existing Deeplead plan, and each tool states its credit price.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: local business search, company search and enrichment, professional contact search, email and phone finder, decision maker lookup, contacts, credits and inbox placement tests.
